reviewer: Claude（Claude Code 会话）：faster-whisper small.en 与 medium.en 两档逐词转写交叉核对，并对照本地抽帧；未人工听音

foreground_english.en: First of all, I want to ask Novak, what are you still doing here? Come on.
foreground_english.zh: 先问问诺瓦克：你怎么还在这儿？

foreground_english.en: No jokes apart. What is it, our third final?
foreground_english.zh: 不开玩笑，这是第三次决赛了吧？

foreground_english.en: Maybe not the last. Hope so.
foreground_english.zh: 也许不是最后一次，希望吧。

foreground_english.en: Because you're probably going to be in many more.
I don't know when are you planning to slow down a little bit,
foreground_english.zh: 不知道你打算什么时候慢下来，

foreground_english.en: but congrats to you and your team.
I mean, 24. I feel like I have not a bad career,
and I have 20 titles. You have 24 Grand Slams. Wow.
foreground_english.zh: 我有20个冠军，你有24个大满贯。

review_note: 梅德韦杰夫颁奖致辞原声，两档逐词一致（small 153.56–182.84；medium 153.28–184.86）。段尾 185.7 在下一句 And so yeah（185.90）之前。
